text:
sam: hey @mira — day 2 and I'm stuck. When I connect to the corporate VPN (split-tunnel) on my Mac, public traffic is fine but I can't reach our internal npm registry npm.redwood.local. I can SSH into the bastion but `curl` from my laptop just hangs. any quick checks?

mira: welcome aboard sam! can you tell us which VPN client/version and paste `curl -v http://npm.redwood.local` output (or `dig +short npm.redwood.local`)?

sam: using WireGuard profile (macOS 13.6). `curl` just times out, no DNS answer. from the bastion `curl http://npm.redwood.local` returns html.

alex: sounds like split-tunnel isn't pushing internal DNS or routes. quick test: run `dig +short npm.redwood.local` on your laptop and on the bastion. if laptop returns nothing or a public IP, that's the issue.

sam: dig on laptop returns nothing; on bastion it returns 10.2.5.12.

mira: yep DNS not being pushed. infra controls split-dns. i can open a ticket, but short-term workarounds: 1) add an /etc/hosts entry mapping npm.redwood.local -> 10.2.5.12 (sudo required), or 2) create an SSH tunnel through the bastion.

sam: tried /etc/hosts (sudo) but npm install fails with a cert error (internal cert).

lucy: for certed services I usually use an SSH tunnel to avoid messing with system CAs. Example: `ssh -L 4873:10.2.5.12:4873 ubuntu@bastion.redwood` then `npm set registry http://localhost:4873`. For generic HTTP you can also do `ssh -D 1080 ubuntu@bastion.redwood` and set a SOCKS proxy.

sam: nice — `ssh -L` worked! had to point npm to localhost:4873 and auth passed.

it-bot: created ticket #3921: "push split-DNS for sam (npm.redwood.local)" assigned to @mira. ETA 1 business day.

mira: thanks @it-bot. @sam i'll follow up in the ticket and see if we can add the domain to the VPN split-dns or push a route. if you want i can add an ssh config entry for convenience: in `~/.ssh/config` add:

```
Host bastion.redwood
  HostName bastion.redwood
  User ubuntu
  LocalForward 4873 10.2.5.12:4873
```

then `ssh bastion.redwood` will create the tunnel automatically.

sam: that's perfect, thanks everyone — tunnel fixed my workflow for now. appreciate the quick help :heart:
